text:
Type: large high-pile area rug
Use: softening a large seating area; living room, bedroom
Style: contemporary, modern, retro
Materials: dense soft high pile, carved relief pattern
Colors: dark taupe brown, light beige
Shape: large rectangle with alternating wavy horizontal bands, sculpted raised texture, thick and plush, substantial visual weight
Feel: warm, cosy, soft, inviting
Goes with: brown or beige sofas, dark or medium wood, cream walls; modern or contemporary living rooms

product.name: MULLERUP
product.description: The high pile dampens sound and provides a soft surface to walk on.
